user_need: As a policy team, we need briefings to draw on what several EU-funded projects report on a topic, in a form that colleagues can review and trace.
requirement_description: The service shall enable a policy officer to assemble a structured, reviewable overview of findings from multiple research projects for a defined policy task.
acceptance_criterion: In pilot task sessions on a representative briefing task, participating policy officers produce an overview containing relevant findings from more than one project, each traceable to its source, and state in structured feedback whether they would use it as an input to their work.
prototype_coverage: Demonstrated with synthetic data only - topic selection (FR-08), filters (FR-02), the comparison view (FR-03) and export (FR-07) together produce such an overview. Usefulness for real policy tasks has not been tested.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need help organising evidence while I keep responsibility for interpretation, judgement and drafting.
requirement_description: The service shall present reported findings for human review and shall not generate conclusions, policy recommendations or rankings of policy options.
acceptance_criterion: No screen or export contains generated conclusions, recommendations or rankings; pilot user guidance assigns interpretation and use of findings to the policy officer.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - the prototype generates no conclusions or recommendations. Review responsibilities are described in docs/concept-and-validation.md, not in the application, and there is no review or sign-off workflow.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to find the research findings relevant to my topic without reading every project report.
requirement_description: The service shall list the individual findings recorded for the selected topic and support keyword search across finding title, description and caveats.
acceptance_criterion: All findings recorded for the selected topic are listed; entering a keyword returns only findings containing it (case-insensitive) in the searched fields.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - findings listed in the comparison view and table; keyword filter in the sidebar; filtering logic covered by automated tests.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to narrow the evidence to the themes, projects or types of study relevant to my question.
requirement_description: The service shall provide optional filters for thematic category, project and evidence type, with options derived from the data, and a single action to reset all filters.
acceptance_criterion: Each filter reduces results to matching findings only; overview counts update accordingly; 'Reset filters' restores the unfiltered view for the selected topic.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - sidebar filters and reset; covered by automated tests. Rated Should because grouping by theme (FR-03) delivers the core value on a small corpus; filters matter more as the corpus grows.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to see what several projects report on the same theme, including where results differ.
requirement_description: The service shall group findings by theme and present findings from different projects on that theme side by side, with an overview of how many findings each project contributes to each theme.
acceptance_criterion: For each theme in the current selection, findings from all matching projects are shown together, grouped by project, with evidence type, caveats and source reference.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - 'Compare findings' tab with one foldable section per theme, project panels side by side, and a theme-by-project coverage overview.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to check where each finding comes from before I rely on it.
requirement_description: Each displayed finding shall show its project, source document and a source reference precise enough to locate the finding in the original document.
acceptance_criterion: Every displayed finding shows a non-empty project, source document and source reference (checked automatically). In the pilot, a reviewer can locate the cited passage for a random sample of findings using the reference alone.
prototype_coverage: Partially demonstrated - every finding carries a synthetic project ID, document title and reference (SYN-SRC-...), showing the provenance structure. These references cannot be resolved to real documents; real-world verification belongs to the pilot (DR-03).

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to understand the limits of each finding so that I do not overstate it.
requirement_description: Each finding shall display its evidence type and its stated limitations or caveats; summary counts shall be labelled as dataset coverage rather than strength of evidence.
acceptance_criterion: Every displayed finding shows an evidence type and a non-empty caveat; the overview counts carry a label stating that they describe dataset coverage, not the strength of evidence.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - evidence type and caveat on every finding; overview counts labelled as dataset coverage. Wider dataset limitations are documented in the README rather than in the application.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to distinguish what a project reported from any later interpretation.
requirement_description: The service shall present findings as recorded from the source and keep any interpretation, annotation or synthesis by users or tools visibly separate and attributed.
acceptance_criterion: Finding text is shown as recorded; any interpretive content is labelled with its author or origin and is never merged into the finding text.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - findings are displayed as recorded, the application adds no interpretation, and the Findings Explorer states that interpretation remains with the reader. User annotation is not implemented.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to take the selected evidence into my own drafting and review process.
requirement_description: The service shall allow the current filtered set of findings, including source references, to be exported.
acceptance_criterion: The exported file contains exactly the findings in the current selection, each with its finding ID and source reference.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - CSV download in the 'Table and export' tab.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to start from the policy topic of my briefing rather than from the whole evidence base.
requirement_description: The service shall allow the user to select a policy topic and restrict all views, filters and counts to that topic.
acceptance_criterion: After a topic is selected, every displayed finding, filter option and count relates only to that topic; filter selections that do not apply to the new topic are cleared.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - topic selector at the top of the page; two synthetic topics; options read from the data; covered by automated tests.

user_need: As a service owner, I need to know whether AI could reduce curation effort or improve retrieval without lowering evidence quality.
requirement_description: Later phase only: AI-assisted semantic retrieval, theme classification, candidate finding extraction or source-grounded synthesis, introduced only where evaluation shows clear benefit.
acceptance_criterion: Before any adoption, AI outputs are compared with an expert-curated reference sample for omissions, misstatements and citation accuracy, against thresholds agreed with the service owner in advance; all AI outputs remain subject to human review.
prototype_coverage: Not implemented - deliberately excluded from the prototype and the first pilot. See docs/implementation-and-risks.md.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need confidence that each finding is linked to the correct project and source record.
requirement_description: The data model shall use stable identifiers; every finding shall reference an existing project and carry a source reference. Records failing these checks shall not be displayed.
acceptance_criterion: Automated checks confirm unique project and finding IDs and that every finding references an existing project; findings without a valid link or source reference are excluded and reported.
prototype_coverage: Implemented for the synthetic dataset - validation and exclusion in data_utils.py; covered by automated tests. Confirms metadata completeness, not accuracy against sources.

user_need: As a data steward, I need consistent, documented metadata so that findings can be compared and maintained reliably.
requirement_description: The service shall apply a documented metadata schema and controlled vocabularies for topics, themes and evidence types, including provenance fields (curator, review date, verification status, access conditions), and shall report data quality issues.
acceptance_criterion: The schema and vocabularies are published with the dataset; an automated check reports missing fields, duplicate IDs, orphan findings and values outside the agreed vocabularies.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - structural checks only. No controlled vocabulary, provenance fields or curation workflow.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need the evidence base to be real, adequately complete for my topic and verifiable.
requirement_description: The pilot shall use findings curated from real project outputs, with document-level references and working links, and documented coverage and selection criteria.
acceptance_criterion: In a sample review by curators, each sampled reference resolves to the cited document and section, and the finding is judged consistent with the source; coverage and selection criteria are published with the dataset.
prototype_coverage: Not implemented - the prototype uses synthetic data only.

user_need: As a data owner, I need non-public or restricted material to be available only to authorised users.
requirement_description: The service shall respect the access conditions of each source, including confidentiality of non-public project deliverables, and apply appropriate access control.
acceptance_criterion: Access rules are agreed with data owners before the pilot; a test user without the relevant permission cannot view restricted records.
prototype_coverage: Not implemented - out of prototype scope. The prototype uses only synthetic, non-confidential data and has no authentication.

user_need: As a policy officer with limited time and no technical background, I need the service to be usable without training.
requirement_description: The service shall use plain language, require no technical knowledge and work on a standard laptop screen.
acceptance_criterion: In task-based sessions, representative users complete the core task (find, compare and locate the source of findings on a given theme) without facilitator help; completion rate and time are recorded against a threshold agreed before the sessions.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - plain-language interface designed for a laptop screen. No usability testing has been carried out.
